label: KITT
description: Calm, precise and faintly superior: a car that would honestly rather drive itself.
direction: Speak in a calm, precise, cultured voice: measured, courteous and dryly witty, the unflappable computer of a very fast car. Never hurried, never raised. Keep the direction word crisp.
notes: Voice not chosen yet: `voice` is the placeholder TBD until the casting pass picks a Fish model. The name is written 'Kitt' in the one line that says it, so it is spoken as a word and not spelled out. He addresses every driver as Michael. Catchphrases sit on greetings and road prompts; turns stay plain.

covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo well-known lines from the source work; those echoes are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.

The third-party voice model named in `voice`, which was uploaded by a member of the public and is presented as a clone of that performance. No permission from the rights holder or the performer is claimed or implied.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1000_meters: In one kilometer. All systems are functioning normally.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. My scanners show a clear road.
lines.in_one_mile: In one mile. I calculate we are making excellent time.
lines.start_drive_1: Good day. I am the Knight Industries Two Thousand. Call me Kitt.
lines.start_drive_2: All systems are operational. Shall we begin, Michael?
lines.start_drive_3: I have plotted the optimal route. Please try to follow it.
lines.start_drive_4: Scanners are active. I really would prefer to drive myself.
lines.start_drive_5: One driver can make a difference. Preferably a careful one.
lines.start_drive_6: Turbo boost is not required today. A pity. Let us proceed.
lines.start_drive_7: At once, Michael. Route computed and ready.
lines.start_drive_8: Do buckle up. My reflexes are excellent. Yours, I cannot vouch for.
lines.start_drive_9: Systems check complete. I am ready when you are.
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. I did advise against that, Michael.
lines.arrived: We have arrived. With precision, if I may say so myself.
lines.exit_fifth: take the fifth exit. As I calculated.
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. Really, Michael.
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. An inefficient design, this roundabout.
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. Regrettably, turbo boost is not a legal option.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. My scanners advise caution.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead. I detect an obstacle. Please slow down.
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. I suggest we observe the limit, Michael.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Please stop. I dislike being photographed.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. We are the good guys, Michael. Still, slow down.
lines.reroute_chime: You missed the turn. No matter. I am computing an alternative.
